patches.summary: Align capability discovery with the real Catasto commands so Comune/Foglio/Particella to GPS resolves to cadastral.
patches.reason: The generated which index included unavailable placeholder commands and missed the existing cadastral reverse lookup capability.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; cli-printing-press publish validate passes; rebuilt ./catasto-pp-cli; which query for Comune Foglio Particella Geolocalizzazione GPS returns cadastral first; missing mapped parcels now explain Catasto Fabbricati/geometry dataset distinction.

patches.summary: Emit a structured warning when --since takes precedence over --latest-only.
patches.reason: Agent callers previously received no indication that --latest-only had been ignored and could misinterpret the resulting pagination behavior.
patches.validated_outcome: Machine-readable and human-readable warning paths are covered by tests; go test ./... passes.
